title: Cohere Model Attestation Predicate
description: Custom in-toto predicate for the Cohere confidential computing model attestation ledger. Each predicate represents one model's attestation state at a point in time, forming a verifiable chain via previous_rekor_log_index.

model_path.description: Model identifier matching the folder name under models/ (e.g. 'command-r-plus').

event_type.description: What happened in this ledger entry. policy_activated: a new policy was created from fresh measurements. policy_deprecated: routine retirement. policy_revoked: emergency removal due to security incident.

event_reason.description: Optional human-readable explanation for this event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this predicate was generated.

release_version.description: The version tag of the GitHub release containing this attestation (e.g. 'v0.0.1').

measurements.description: TDX measurement register values computed by cvm-measure. Each value is a 96-character hex string (48 bytes / 384 bits).

mrtd.description: Measurement of the TD (MRTD) -- covers firmware, kernel, and initial TD configuration.

rtmr3.description: Runtime Measurement Register 3 -- derived from initdata (Kata agent policy hash).

policy_id.description: The ITA attestation policy UUID. This single policy ID covers all models in the release.

rego_policy_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the full Kata agent Rego policy text. The full policy is available as a release artifact.

initdata_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the base64-encoded initdata blob that genpolicy produced.

previous_rekor_log_index.description: Rekor transparency log index of this model's previous attestation entry. 0 for the genesis entry (first ever attestation for this model). Forms a per-model linked list in Rekor.

tool_versions.description: Versions of the tools used to produce this attestation. Enables reproducibility.

genpolicy.description: Version of the Kata genpolicy binary (from Kata release tag).

cvm_measure.description: Version of the cvm-measure tool (pip show cvm-measure).

source_artifacts.description: References to the input artifacts used to compute measurements. Enables auditors to reproduce the computation.

firmware_ref.description: Reference to the OVMF firmware used (URL, SHA, or GCP image name).

uki_ref.description: Reference to the Unified Kernel Image (BOOTX64.EFI) used.

baseline_ref.description: Reference to the baseline JSON (e.g. cohere-cc-baselines commit SHA or URL).
